    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersMarshall College diner friesThick twice-fried fries with flaky salt in paper cones, tomato sauceHow to make it1kg potatoes, cut into thick fries2 L vegetable oil2 tsp flaky salt4 tbsp tomato sauceCut the potatoes into thick fries, rinse and dry well.Fry in the vegetable oil at 140°C for 6 minutes, then rest.Fry again at 190°C until crisp.Salt with flaky salt and serve in paper cones with tomato sauce.Peruvian ceviche cupsSnapper cured in lime juice with red onion, chilli and coriander, sweet potato and cornHow to make it400g snapper fillets, very fresh, diced6 limes, juiced1 red onion, thinly sliced1 red chilli, chopped2 tbsp chopped coriander1 sweet potato, boiled and cubed100g corn kernelsBoil the sweet potato until tender, then cool and cube.Dice the snapper and cover with lime juice for 15 minutes.Add the onion, chilli and coriander. Serve in small cups with the sweet potato and corn.MainsPeruvian chicken with green sauceCharred garlic cumin drumsticks with green coriander jalapeño sauce, and friesHow to make it1.2kg chicken drumsticks3 garlic cloves, crushed1 tsp ground cumin2 tsp smoked paprika2 limes, juiced1 cup coriander leaves1 jalapeno100g mayonnaise1kg potatoes, cut into fries2 L vegetable oilMarinate the drumsticks in the garlic, cumin, paprika and lime juice.Roast at 220°C until charred and cooked through.Blitz the coriander, jalapeno, mayonnaise and a squeeze of lime for the sauce.Cut the potatoes into fries and fry them twice in the vegetable oil, first at a low heat then until crisp. Serve with the chicken.Peruvian lomo saltadoThe jungle chase in the AmazonHow to make itAs written, serves 4Rump strips seared in a smoking wok with red onion, tomato, soy and vinegar, tossed with crisp chips and served with rice the Peruvian way.Cook 1kg frozen chips at 220°C until crisp.Cook 300g rice.Slice 700g rump steak into strips and toss with soy, garlic and cumin.Sear in a smoking wok in batches for 1 minute.Add a red onion in wedges and 2 tomatoes in wedges and toss 1 minute.Add 3 tbsp soy and 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, return the beef, toss with the chips and coriander.Serve with rice.SweetsAkator crystal skull jellyClear lemon jelly set with green grapes and blueberriesHow to make it6 gelatine sheets500ml water150g caster sugar3 lemons, juiced200g green grapes, halved125g blueberriesSoak the gelatine sheets in cold water.Heat the water, sugar and lemon juice, then stir in the squeezed gelatine.Layer the grapes and blueberries in glasses and pour over the jelly.Set for 4 hours in the fridge.DrinksMutt's greaser malt shakeThick vanilla malted milkshakes in tall glassesHow to make it12 scoops of vanilla ice cream600ml cold milk4 tbsp malted milk powderBlend the ice cream, milk and malt powder in batches until thick.Pour into tall glasses and serve at once.
